title: STM32-Style GPIO Register Map Struct
description:
C struct overlays map directly onto memory-mapped hardware peripheral addresses.

### Modern MCU GPIO Architecture (STM32):
- `MODER`: 2 bits per pin for input, output, alternate function, or analog.
- `BSRR`: Bit Set/Reset Register. Writing 1 to bits [15:0] sets the pin; writing 1 to bits [31:16] clears it. This allows atomic single-instruction pin toggles without race conditions.
- `IDR`: Input Data Register containing live pin voltage levels.
hint: BSRR avoids the classical read-modify-write hazard (`ODR |= (1 << pin)`) where an ISR preemption between read and write would lose changes.
